newsitem.title: GERMANY: Postbank says regrets BHW JV withdrawl.
newsitem.headline: Postbank says regrets BHW JV withdrawl.

text.p: Germany's Postbank AG said on Tuesday it regretted that financial services group BHW Holding AG had dropped plans to set up a product partnership with Postbank and to buy a stake in it.
"A promising partnership with BHW could have developed," a Postbank spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
The spokesman said Postbank had not yet decided on a partner in the mortgage finance sector and that the Wuestenrot group was the only remaining candidate at present.
BHW, which has long said it aimed to cooperate closely with Postbank, said on Tuesday that revised government terms for such a partnership made the prospect of taking a stake in the bank unviable.
It said a stake in Postbank would not be in the interest of BHW shareholders.

BHW also said it had sold its remaining 10.5 percent stake in DSL Holding AG, a state-controlled bank, as it no longer fulfilled any strategic function. The shares had been sold to a number of large banks, BHW said.
Meanwhile DSL said it had not yet been informed which banks had acquired the DSL shares from BHW.
BHW said it could not rule out the possibility that Postbank had bought the shares but the Postbank spokesman said his bank did not have a stake in DSL.
Deutsche Bank AG, Germany's biggest commercial bank, said it had not bought any shares in DSL.
